title: RECEIVE SET(ptr) and RETRIEVE SET(ptr) into a POINTER variable: LENGTH is output only and bounds the SET ADDRESS OF view; a short input, LENGTH equal to the START FROM length, ENDDATA

scenarios.summary: CARCST RECEIVEs SET the 6 typed bytes 'CA0D S' into a pointer: LENGTH 6, the view read only through LS-IN(1:6)
START INTERVAL(0) FROM 20 bytes: CARTWK RETRIEVEs SET, LENGTH 20 equals the FROM length and the view reads the 20 bytes, then the second RETRIEVE is ENDDATA
START INTERVAL(0) with no FROM: the first RETRIEVE SET is ENDDATA and the program reads neither pointer nor LENGTH
